# Projium

> Local dashboard (Node 24, no packages to install, 127.0.0.1 only) over Markdown project notes, read in place in the owner's own layout, field names and status words (config `cards`, discovered with `npm run --silent survey`): stages, tasks, milestone times, readiness-audit freshness against git, site uptime, prod feature flags, and build time split from Claude Code transcripts (only timestamps and event kinds are kept; message text never leaves the parser). Agents install it with AGENTS.md, check it with `npm run --silent doctor` (JSON), run it with `npm run --silent start:bg` and use it through an MCP server over stdio (`scripts/mcp.mjs`) or a local HTTP API.

## Setup

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step playbook for an agent installing Projium for its owner, with ground rules and checks
- [README.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/README.md): features, config keys, privacy and safety
- [tracker.config.schema.json](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/tracker.config.schema.json): JSON schema of the config file

## Formats

- [docs/card-format.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/docs/card-format.md): card frontmatter, tasks, readiness file, repo conventions
- [docs/card-template.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/docs/card-template.md): a card to copy

## Use

- [docs/mcp.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/docs/mcp.md): MCP server for the owner's agents: tools, registration for Claude Code, Codex and mcpServers JSON
- [docs/api.md](https://github.com/egorb2302/Projium/blob/main/docs/api.md): read projects, set fields, add and toggle tasks over HTTP
